expected_response.coordinate_control: incumbent pointcloud_delta_A=1.0, teacher_neighbors=4, no regional or temporal attention change

failure_modes: Treating pair-kernel or moment diagnostics as terms of the executing pointcloud scalar would inject a force the registered formula does not contain.
Selecting a single region_index would ignore opposing softmin vs occupancy signs at the same landmark.
Any temporal_region_index or temporal_teacher_blend change would extrapolate beyond observed support [0.0,0.49] where extrapolation_allowed=false.
Reading survival or turnover_residual_rate entries as decoded terminal affinity effects would misstate their semantics.
Proposing a temperature edit would be an interface violation, not a research condition.
rationale: Retain the incumbent. The objective is final predicted target affinity (primary), with validity and strain secondary and coordinate control only; decoded terminal learning labels are unavailable, so no supplied contrast can be read as a decoded terminal affinity outcome. All observables are endpoint forecast descriptors in predicted_endpoint_world_A (soft_mass, landmark softmin/occupancy, pair kernels, shape and regional moments), not interaction energies, velocities, neural attention or causal affinity gradients. The strongest and most internally consistent endpoint contrasts are the pair kernels 1.5-5.0 A (positive, positive_batch_fraction 1.0/1.0/1.0/0.857) with pair_kernel_7.0 opposing (-0.485, fraction 0.0), and all four survive the curve-support audit; however the executing pointcloud scalar contains no pair-kernel term, so this diagnostic cannot be converted into an operative reward edit without treating a diagnostic feature as an independent force the registered formula does not contain. Landmark softmin and occupancy3/5 contrasts are mixed in sign at the same landmark (e.g. landmark_00_softmin -0.481 vs landmark_00_occupancy3 0.545; landmark_02_softmin +0.253 vs landmark_02_occupancy5 -0.323; landmark_06_softmin +0.294 vs landmark_06_occupancy3/5 negative), so no single region_index carries one defensible favorable direction. Shape effects are predominantly negative and joint innovation/internal RMS contrasts are consistently negative, but these are standardized coordinate and branch-adjusted covariance contrasts, not strain energies or rigid-motion residuals of a physical trajectory. All continuous fits are observed_node_linear with polynomial_accepted=false, extrapolation_allowed=false and many strong sign conflicts, so any temporal_region_index or temporal_teacher_blend change would rest on within-support interpolation only and cannot be justified outside the observed window. Survival enrichment effects are weak and mostly non-significant after BH, and turnover_residual_rate entries are descriptive, dominated by score reclassification and extant-parent weighting rather than resampling. The information audit and joint diagnostics are within-selector associations with batch as the independent unit (compressed_choice_excess_fixed_RMS_A 0.081, top4_teacher_overlap 0.470; native alignment +0.092, observed_child_score_gain -0.036), not causal affinity effects. No registered bounded declarative edit (pointcloud_delta_A, region_index, teacher_neighbors, temporal_region_index, temporal_teacher_blend) has a defensible expected advantage over the incumbent under the affinity-first priority, and temperatures are immutable. Retaining the incumbent is therefore the evidence-supported choice; the decision would change if a supplied contrast were tied to a term actually present in the executing pointcloud scalar with consistent batch direction and a defensible expected affinity advantage.
